name: Faye Walker
caption: A contortionist and former Cirque du Soleil performer who obeys only Kaira Hastings, and who submitted Crash Carson in 39 seconds at the first Power Trip.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-10 to 2007-05-16.

name: Kaira Hastings
caption: The spoiled, arrogant former ballet dancer who handles Faye Walker and interferes in her matches; the other half of The Cat's Meow.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-10 to 2007-05-14.

name: Hornswagglin' Huck
caption: A fiddle-playing Georgia hillbilly who arrives at the first Power Trip with his pig, Hoss, and beats Johnny Triton with a full nelson.

entrance_music.title: The Devil Went Down to Georgia
entrance_music.verbatim: 'The Devil Went Down to Georgia' by the Charlie Daniels Band

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-11 to 2007-05-16.

name: Hoss
caption: Hornswagglin' Huck's pig, tied to the corner post of the first Power Trip's ring.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-26 to 2007-05-14.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Ricky Bernero
caption: A gymnast-turned-wrestler billed Risky Business who joins for his summer break and is booked against Hida Yakamo.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-14 to 2007-05-16.

name: Otaku
caption: An anime-obsessed rookie who won his first match at the Power Trip debut, submitting Marshall Law with the Angel Wings.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-14 to 2007-05-16.

identity.note: Same bare ring name as the EPW wing's Otaku (2007 to 2011) and a 2007 TEAM tournament entrant; those records carry no bio. This fed's Otaku is a 6'1" anime fan from Neo Tokyo Tower. Nothing but the name links them.

name: AC Blood
caption: The Broken Mould, whose promos sneered at the fed's interviewer and at 'T-shirts and movie deals', and who headlined the first Power Trip against Chris Carmody.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-22 to 2007-05-16.

name: Trey Moore
caption: A brash Greensboro rookie booked in a three-way with Gravedigger and Tex.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-05-06 to 2007-05-13.

name: Gravedigger
caption: A 6'11" Portland veteran back from retirement who demands a match and is booked in the three-way with Trey Moore and Tex.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-05-07 to 2007-05-13.

identity.note: A common ring name, held on several wings from 1997 to 2000; this fed's Gravedigger is a 6'11" Portland veteran who says he left 'SCW'. Nothing links them.

name: Tex
caption: A cartoon-masked 5'3" wrestler from Termite Terrace who answers Gravedigger and Trey Moore with a 'hunting season' promo.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-05-07 to 2007-05-14.

identity.note: Same bare name as a 1996 USEW tag wrestler; this fed's Tex is a cartoon-masked 5'3" wrestler from Termite Terrace. Nothing links them.

name: Marshall Law
caption: Otaku's debut opponent at the first Power Trip.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-28 to 2007-04-28.

identity.note: Same name as a 2006 Anarchy Wrestling wrestler; one-match debut opponent here. Nothing links them.

name: Johnny Triton
caption: Hornswagglin' Huck's debut opponent at the first Power Trip.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-28 to 2007-04-28.

name: Crash Carson
caption: The average-sized wrestler Faye Walker submitted in 39 seconds at the first Power Trip.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 2007-04-28 to 2007-04-28.

caption: Billed The Complex, AC Blood's opponent in the first Power Trip's main event.
